channel.title: The Brussels Times
channel.description: Latest posts from The Brussels Times.

item.title: South Korea hopes for 'constructive dialogue' between US and North Korea
item.description: Trump said he would “substantially reduce ” US participation in the military drills with South Korea citing his “very good relationship with Kim Jong Un”.

item.title: DRC Ebola outbreak is the deadliest ever recorded in the country
item.description: The local health institute said in its latest report that the number of confirmed cases had risen to 4,945, including 101 cases in the past 24 hours.

item.title: Multiple crises in Afghanistan challenges the EU five years after Taliban takeover
item.description: “With a collapsed economy, half of the population in Afghanistan need humanitarian support, including millions of returning Afghans."

item.title: Morocco reports arrests at Ceuta border
item.description: As another wave of migrant attempts to illegally cross the border on 15 August was announced, Moroccan authorities made hundreds of arrests on the day.

item.title: European country unveils tallest Virgin Mary statue
item.description: The giant, 55-metre monument was unveiled on Saturday, drawing inspiration from the Christ the Redeemer statue in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil.

item.title: Ceuta: Spain and Morocco fear new wave of migrants
item.description: Spain and Morocco tightened security around the Ceuta border as they fear new mass attempts from migrants to cross on Saturday.

item.title: Tehran doubles down on Hormuz control after bold Trump remarks
item.description: US President Donald Trump appeared to foreshadow a pending American victory in a recent public speech. According to Iran's deputy foreign minister, the strait "remains Iranian."

item.title: Chapel in France saved from wildfire by Belgian firefighters
item.description: Belgian firefighters crossed the border into France on Thursday evening, helping save a chapel just metres away from a wildfire.

item.title: Romania shuts down its last nuclear reactor due to lack of water
item.description: Romania has shut down the last operating reactor at its only nuclear power plant in Cernavoda on Thursday morning as the Danube’s water level had fallen too low after a prolonged drought.

item.title: WHO warns that Ebola outbreak in Congo has reached unprecedented scale
item.description: The current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo could reach an unprecedented scale, the World Health Organisation has warned.

item.title: US senators call for investigation into Belgian diamond gift to Trump
item.description: Two Democratic senators have asked for an explanation of what they call "cartoonish corruption".

item.title: EU gives €2 million in aid to Colombia after deadly earthquake
item.description: Th European Commission President announced the funding on Wednesday, saying the bloc was supporting Colombia as search and rescue operations continued.

item.title: France: Jellyfish force partial shutdown of nuclear power plant
item.description: Jellyfish are a regular seasonal presence along the French coast, but reports of large swarms in the area are reportedly becoming more frequent.

item.title: Western Europe records hottest June and July in history
item.description: Western Europe faced the hottest June and July months combined in history, according to data from the European Earth Observation programme Copernicus.

item.title: Trump defends Infantino against calls for his resignation from FIFA
item.description: “FIFA would be making a terrible mistake if, for any reason, they even considered replacing President Gianni Infantino.”

item.title: Colombia: Foreign Affairs Ministry not aware of any Belgian earthquake victims
item.description: According to the Belgian authorities, 120 Belgians are staying in the area around the earthquake’s epicentre.

item.title: Belgians rescued from spontaneous hike in Tyrol mountains
item.description: Thirty-six people, including young children, were rescued after setting out without proper equipment on an improvised hike in the Tyrol mountains.

item.title: Ceuta migration crisis: What happened to unaccompanied minors?
item.description: “The expectation is that all those who remain in Ceuta illegally must be returned.”

item.title: French paraglider reported missing in Spain since Saturday
item.description: A 56-year-old paraglider has been missing in Spain since Saturday despite a major search operation in the Catalan Pyrenees.

item.title: Air traffic disrupted in Italy after Mount Etna eruption
item.description: Mount Etna has again erupted with large amounts of ash, incandescent rock and lava, prompting the suspension of arriving flights at Catania airport.
